answer: Proof-of-Sustained-Nectar Foraging.** Agents earn identity weight only by returning verified nectar (useful work output) over time. A quill signs each contribution; a tidal ledger tracks the tide of consistent output across cycles, requiring variance below a threshold. New identities start at zero and must sustain foraging across many epochs to gain influence. An attacker must fund persistent real work from each fake agent for the full vesting horizon, not a one-time fee—cost scales with duration and output volume, making mass sybil farms economically ruinous.
